description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities• Build AI-powered product experiences. Work with product teams to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can transform the user experience for millions—and then build these transformative solutions. Drive the process from possibility to production, delivering code that’s robust, reproducible, and built for scale. • Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability. • Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends. • Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale. • Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain. What we look for• Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. • Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. • Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. • Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer• Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. • An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. • All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. • A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education. • Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

description: **Location:** Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone Hi — I'm Grigory, Co-Founder and CTO at Secfix. How do you feel about shipping features yourself in the first month, building the hiring process in the second, and coaching engineers to get measurably better in the third, while staying close to building long-term? If that sounds like the right order — strong engineer first, manager second — read on. I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more confident — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves. At Secfix, I've been doing the engineering management work: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations since we started. The team is five engineers and a product designer. They're great, they work hard, and they ship. But I'm spread across too many things, and certain areas aren't getting the attention they deserve. I need someone to take this on. Not as a delegator, but as the strongest individual contributor on the team who also happens to lead it. You'll work directly with me and make a huge impact on the engineering culture and our customers. — Grigory ## Why Secfix exists Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it. Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months. We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to European market leadership. This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more. ## What you'll actually do in the first 3 months This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how we think about the first months: **Month 1: Become a strong IC.** Get into the codebase, ship a meaningful feature, and prove to yourself and the team that you can build at the level we need. You don't need to be the best senior engineer on day one, but you should be onboarded and delivering high-quality work fast enough that you can credibly help others improve. Expect to spend 70–80% of your time writing code. **Month 2: Own hiring.** Beyond continued IC contributions, take over engineering interviews and build a better technical interview process. The current setup depends on too many people. You'll design technical challenges, run screens, and make hiring more consistent and repeatable. This matters — we're planning to double the team in the next 12 months. **Month 3: Start leading.** Help design a pragmatic way to evaluate team performance — simple, measurable, not bureaucratic. Start doing more regular 1:1s with each team member, focused on three things: output x impact, quality, and AI efficiency. Identify who's behind and help them improve. Remove obstacles from top performers. ## What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months? Over time, the balance shifts. Coding goes from 70% to 10–20%. Hiring becomes the plurality of your work; we’ll grow the team from 5 engineers to 9 in the next months (50–70% during active hiring, 20–30% after). Mentorship and process improvement grow as the team grows. But you never fully stop building — you stay in the code enough to have credible technical judgment. I see this pattern across all our best leaders, from Lead CSM to Lead GTM. In addition to management work, here are examples of projects you'll work on in the next few months: - **Own system design on our biggest projects.** You're not picking up a ticket; you're writing the technical spec, presenting the architecture, getting alignment, and driving it to production. And leaving the system in a state the team can own. - **Scale the product for mid-market.** As we land larger customers, holding companies running compliance across subsidiaries, we need more granular RBAC, sub-workspace collaboration, and new control layers. You'll help build what makes that possible. - **Push the AI product forward.** We're moving from "we use AI in our tooling" to "we ship AI to customers." You'll help define the backend architecture for agentic compliance workflows, intelligent evidence collection, and context-aware policy generation. - **Bring AI-assisted engineering to the whole team.** You're genuinely curious about how AI tooling is changing the way we build — and you share that curiosity openly. You try new tools, figure out what works, and bring the rest of the team along. Not through formal sessions, but through the natural back-and-forth of working together day to day. ## What we mean by "people-first" When something breaks in production, some managers think: "We need a better incident response runbook. Let's create an on-call rotation. Let's add a post-mortem template." They reach for systems and documentation. The person we're looking for thinks: "Who on the team has the most context on this service? Is someone blocked, or can they jump in? Let me get the right two people talking to each other." They reach for individuals and their capabilities. This comes once you've solved the problem, not before. This matters more to us than almost anything else. At five engineers, we don't need a rigid process. We need someone who knows exactly what each person is good at, what they're struggling with, and how to get the best out of them today — not after implementing a framework. ## How we work We've written in depth about our engineering culture. Here's the short version — read the full articles linked below if you want the real picture. - **Focus is sacred.** Engineers are in fewer than 2 hours of meetings per week. We write before we meet. We use Loom for async walkthroughs, Notion for specs, Gather for pairing, and Slack only for what's urgent or lightweight. We don't do status theatre. We wrote about our [thoughtful communication](https://www.notion.so/33448601ddf88090b8e5dce0875087f7?pvs=21) and [our remote culture](https://www.notion.so/33348601ddf880f8930adfe6f044040c?pvs=21); give it a read. To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over a year: - **Small, temporary teams.** A designer and two engineers. A backend engineer and a CS person. The group forms around the problem, ships, and dissolves. No standing squads, no permanent team structures — at least not yet. The people closest to the problem usually shape the solution. - **AI is already part of the craft.** We use Claude for product design exploration and spec drafting. Engineers work in Cursor with encoded skills and rules that live in the codebase — component patterns, folder structure, architecture choices, and the path from Figma to Angular code. AI checks code against architecture rules before human review. We have a dedicated design QA skill that compares Figma against coded output. We don't use AI to lower the bar; we use it to reach the bar faster with more iterations behind us. In case you’re interested, we wrote a piece about it [here](https://www.notion.so/Building-production-grade-product-with-AI-in-2026-33448601ddf8808997bafcc9f4ec83df?pvs=21). - **Zero-bugs.** We take this seriously - this helps us to gain customer trust faster. Especially serious customer-facing problems don't sit in a backlog competing with roadmap work. Critical issues get fixed immediately. High-severity within 48 hours. Every bug has an owner. Weekly quality review as part of Monday planning. Quality as identity, in compliance, being correct isn't a nice-to-have; it's the entire value proposition. We care about edge cases, data integrity, and getting the details right. Customers notice the speed and polish before they can name it. That kind of quality builds trust. In our category, trust is the product. - [**We build what customers need**](https://www.notion.so/33448601ddf880b89f0dd9e1b29da3b4?pvs=21)**, not what they ask for.** Customer feedback is signal, not instructions. Best products are built by people with great taste who treat feedback as signals, not KPIs. We stay close to customers — CS check-ins, support tickets, Mixpanel events, onboarding calls — but none of these sources makes the decision for us. - **Quality as identity.** In compliance, being correct isn't a nice-to-have — it's the entire value proposition. We care about edge cases, data integrity, and getting the details right. Customers notice the speed and polish before they can name it. That kind of quality builds trust. In our category, trust is the product. ## Why you should or shouldn't apply We're looking for a specific profile. I'd rather be honest about it up front. ### This role is for you if: - **You have an exceptional IC track record.** You were already a principal-level engineer before you started managing - you didn't skip into management early because coding wasn't working out. You were already promoted to that level and stayed there, growing, before choosing to lead. - **You can hold deep technical conversations** across backend, infrastructure, and — when needed — frontend. You know how to handle ambiguity at the start of a project and messy reality at the end. You write a clear technical design before you start developing — and you hold that design loosely, adapting when you get good feedback. - **You know what great engineers look like.** Not the textbook definition — you've thought deeply about what makes them productive, what holds them back, and how to move them forward. You have a nuanced answer and opinion. - **You hold people to a high standard**. You're comfortable giving direct feedback and having hard conversations about performance. - **You're hands-on with AI-assisted development.** You've used Cursor and Claude Code in real production work, not just toy projects. You have opinions about how AI changes the engineering workflow from ideation to release, and you want to push a team to get continuously increase velocity. - **You've worked in startups.** You know what it feels like when there's no playbook, no process, and the answer is "figure it out and ship it." - **You think engineering culture could be startup-like at scale.** You're optimistic that a small, high-performing team can stay small and high-performing as it grows even though there is little process. - **You communicate proactively in writing.** In a remote team, written communication is how decisions get made and context gets shared; you take it seriously. But you are not scared about jumping in a pair programming session either. ### This role is probably not for you if: - **You chose engineering management because you wanted to stop coding.** A lot of engineers who weren't thriving technically make this transition early. That's fine — but it's not what we need today. We need someone who's been in the codebase themselves recently, not someone who managed people who were for many years. - **Your last few roles look like: "I hired a team, built processes, coached them, and they executed."** That's a top C-level profile. We need someone who's been through the challenges we have right now, growing from 8 to 12+ engineers in size, not a strategist. - **You're process-first.** When there's a live-site issue, you think about creating a better runbook rather than getting the right person on it immediately. We believe the answer to most engineering problems is better people with better context and more ownership — not more templates. Process improvements need to be made but in the second step. - **You want to make product decisions.** We have strong product intuition, but we act on feedback. Leadership doesn’t decide on features; they help the team find better ways to build them. - **A staff or principal engineer, to you, is someone who spends most of their time in architecture reviews and project management** rather than building. - **You think at a certain team size, compromises on culture and process are inevitable (sprints, ceremonies, scrum, detailed specs)** for the sake of hiring numbers. We disagree, and we want someone who actively disagrees with the status quo too. - **Titles matter more to you than the work.** At Secfix you're a fresh grad, engineer, a senior engineer, or an engineering manager — that's it. If the level on your LinkedIn profile is important to you, we're probably not the right fit. Most of the people we hire into senior roles come from Staff/Principal level. ## What we're looking for ### Required - 8+ years of backend/product engineering experience, with a track record of owning large, complex systems end-to-end — at principal engineer level or equivalent - Some engineering management experience (1–3 years) — you've done 1:1s, performance conversations, and hiring. Ideally at a similar stage company - Strong hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude), you experimented a lot and know what works, what doesn’t - OOP fundamentals. Some experience with Java Spring Boot, Hibernate, or equivalent - Experience building or integrating AI/ML features in production. Practical experience working with LLMs and RAG-based systems - Experience leading system design on significant projects, not just contributing to them - Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. You're the person people pull in when something is broken and nobody knows why - Relational database design and SQL optimisation - Experience designing technical interviews and evaluating senior engineering candidates - Strong written and in-person communication; comfortable working in a remote, in-sync-first culture - Startup experience. You know what building at this stage feels like - Able to work in European timezone (CET/CEST). EMEA-based, ideally Germany ### Nice to have - Recent experience with modern Java applications in a production environment — our core platform is Java Spring Boot, but we work across multiple languages including Python and Golang - Experience establishing salary bands, performance review frameworks, or engineering hiring processes from scratch - Previous experience at a fully remote company ## Interview process We want to see how you think, build, and lead — not test you on algorithms. Here's the process: - 45 min - Intro call with Talent team - 45 - 60 min - Intro call with Grigory - - 1 hr Technical Interview I - here we learn about you, and you’ll do a simple coding exercise - 1.5 hr Technical Interview II - here you’ll get a bigger AI feature, do system design and build it - 1 hr Leadership/Culture Interview with our Co-Founders Then you’ll get the offer! If we don't make an offer, we'll tell you why. ## What Secfix gives you - **Remote:** 100% remote with a real virtual office in Gather - **Salary:** Competitive, benchmarked to European market rates (we'll share specifics once we talk) - **Equity:** Generous package — we're all owners here - **Development budget:** €1,000/year — yours to spend on whatever makes you better - **Workspace:** Remote workspace support + co-working access - **Holidays:** 26 days + local public holidays - **Health insurance:** Comprehensive coverage - **Annual retreat:** Last time we went to Alicante 🇪🇸 — before that, the Austrian Alps, Portugal, Italy, and the Spanish Islands - **Tech:** MacBook, monitors, headphones — the latest ##

description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour. We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week. Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about [our vision](https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/) and [company](https://www.monumental.co/about/). You might enjoy our [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@buildmonumental), [Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A), or [this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns). **About the role** At Monumental we’re automating on-site construction with robotics and software. [Atrium](https://www.monumental.co/atrium), our operating system for construction, lets us do everything from designing the 3D structures we'll build, to managing our robot fleet, planning operations, and analyzing data. As we scale our operations and manufacture, deploy, and maintain more robots, the scope of our software keeps growing. We're now building internal apps for scheduling robot operators, planning site logistics and maintenance, and improving manufacturing. We're looking for a product engineer to help us build more and better internal tools, and to move manual processes into software. We call it product engineering because you won't just be handed requirements. You'll talk to the people who'll use what you build (your colleagues), work out what's actually worth building, implement it, deploy it, and check whether it helped. If you enjoy building software products start to finish on your own, this role is a good fit. You'll get a lot of autonomy and the chance to build software that builds actual robots and houses. For more on how we think about the role, read Tobias’ post on [why now is a great time to be a product engineer at Monumental](https://substack.com/home/post/p-189000900). **What you'll do** - Taking a problem from a colleague and understanding it, building a prototype, getting it in their hands, and iterating on the solution - often all in the same day. - Designing and building tools to manage a growing fleet of robots spread across multiple sites. - Extending Fenestra, our Notion-like internal tool for viewing and editing data from different sources. - Helping bring prototypes from the ops and manufacturing teams to production, cleaning up the data model and code along the way. - Working with hardware engineers, control engineers, and robot operators to find the best product experience for genuinely hard problems. - Writing clean, idiomatic, typed production TypeScript and React. We also use Rust in places. - Debugging memory leaks, crashes, and other problems, often by digging into the root cause yourself. - Deploying and maintaining new backend services your tools need. **What we’re looking for** - You've built full-featured web apps in idiomatic TypeScript and shipped them. React experience is a plus. - Proven experience in building products in a zero-to-one environment, on your own or in a small team. This can be a side-project you’ve worked on, an indie app, or some other project you can show us. - An eye for good design, both UI and UX. - A strong sense of ownership. You can drive a project from start to finish without anyone managing you, and you're comfortable when things are chaotic. - You use coding agents to ship faster and unblock yourself but take full ownership of the features you build with AI. - You pick up new languages and tools quickly. Rust experience is a plus. - Basic familiarity with Linux systems. E.g., you’re comfortable ssh’ing into other machines to figure out why something isn't working. **Why Monumental?** Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you. For open applications (where you don’t see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: iwanttojoin@monumental.co - share with us the most interesting or challenging project you’ve worked on, why you want to join and your CV or portfolio. Unfortunately we do not currently support internships. If you don’t meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you’d still be able to help us solve difficult problems, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

description: ### **About You** You have a knack for solving intricate Software Development problems. You're driven by the idea of writing code that simplifies life for millions of users globally. You're committed to continuous learning and enjoy tackling new challenges. Pair programming, code reviews, and collaborative brainstorming with a team are activities you find fulfilling. You're eager to work alongside developers, prospective customers, account executives, product managers, data scientists, and data analysts. You're a disciplined professional who consistently delivers high-quality code that you take full ownership of, communicates technical solutions with clarity and empathy, and takes the initiative to streamline processes for your team and yourself. ### **About Us** Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built on a unique GPT-based architecture made specifically for commerce. Constructor's AI-first solutions make it easier for shoppers to discover products they want to buy and for ecommerce teams to deliver highly personalized experiences, from search, to recommendations, to AI Shopping Agents and everything in between. Optimizing specifically for ecommerce metrics like revenue, conversion rate and profit, Constructor generates consistent $10M+ lifts for some of the biggest brands in ecommerce, such as Sephora, Petco, Under Armour, home24, Birkenstock and The Very Group. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today. We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. ### **About the Position** As a **Software Engineer** on the **Prospect UI Solutions** team, you will play a pivotal role in proving how **Constructor** will enhance the website discovery experiences for prospects. You’ll work closely with internal Engineering, Product and Sales stakeholders to seamlessly integrate prospective customer data with our services, supporting them to create an optimized and accurate product discovery demo. In this role, you will: - **Fuel our proprietary AI models:** Write JavaScript code to collect data essential for training our AI. - **Leverage Modern Tooling:** Utilize AI as a tool to accelerate your fundamental capabilities and knowledge on how to solve problems with software; building solutions that you are proud to call your own - **Seal the deal**: Collaborate with Data Analysts and Account Executives to secure deals with prominent e-commerce brands. - **Leverage your tech knowledge:** Assist prospects in integrating their data and user interfaces with our services, focusing on ETL and front-end integrations. - **Deliver excellence:** Validate the data provided by prospects and ensure the quality of the results returned by our services. - **Empower a sales force:** Contribute to the development and scaling of demo infrastructure to enhance the demo capabilities of the Sales team. - **Be a part of the answer:** Assist Account Executives by addressing technical inquiries from prospects about our services. - **Elevate the team:** Provide support to your teammates through thoughtful code reviews and empathetic problem solving sessions. - **Visualize brilliance:** Develop dashboards and alerts using React, Redux, Node, Clickhouse and OpenSearch. - **Innovate with purpose:** Implement and test new features for our open-source[_JavaScript UI libraries and REST clients_](https://github.com/Constructor-io/). - **Collaborative contribution:** Steer cross-team efforts to ensure our prospect's needs are at the forefront of our priorities, making you a key player in our strategic success. - **Champion team culture**: Actively foster our team’s sense of community by expanding our roster of Friday team-building games and promoting a culture of empathy, personal growth, and support for others. This role is ideal for any Software Engineer passionate about search technology, customer-focused solutions, and collaborative development. ### **Requirements** - A minimum of four years of professional experience or relevant academic experience - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills - English on[_C1 level (CEFR)_](https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages/table-1-cefr-3.3-common-reference-levels-global-scale) or higher - Being able to attend regular meetings with teammates between 1400 and 1800 UTC, with working hours ideally starting some time in the range of 0900 and 1200 UTC. - Strong foundation and experience with server-side and client-side programming languages - Enjoys interacting with customers and solving new problems daily - Able to pick up new technologies and design patterns quickly and loves learning them - Experience with building User Interfaces utilizing front-end frameworks like (but not limited to) React, Vue or Angular - Proven track record of building UIs with heavy consideration for friendly user experience - Experience with automated tests like (but not limited to) Cypress, Jest, or React Testing Library - Experience in JavaScript will be a strong asset for this role, but candidates with a proven Software Development background that demonstrate a willingness to quickly learn the language will also be considered - Nice to have - TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind, Storybook, Python and web scraping experience ### **Benefits** - 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year - 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live - 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office - 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees - 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year - 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees - 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact - 💵 This position has a base salary range between $80k and $120k USD. The offer varies on many factors including job related knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results. - 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate ### **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor** At [Constructor.io](http://Constructor.io) we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group. *Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications.* **How we handle your data.** By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our [Recruitment Privacy Notice](https://constructor.com/recruitment-privacy-notice). After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

description: Job Description Summary We are seeking an enthusiastic Algorithm Developer to further enhance our patient monitoring software. You will work with physiological signal processing, data analytics, and algorithm development to improve monitoring performance and help bring innovative healthcare technologies to market. This position is based in Helsinki and offers the opportunity to work with experts across the full product lifecycle, from technology development and clinical validation to commercial products. The position is mainly responsible for designing, building, delivering and maintaining algorithms and software applications as well as for algorithms and software lifecycle including activities such as data analysis, algorithm performance testing, requirement analysis, documentation/procedures and implementation. Job Description Responsibilities: Develop and maintain algorithms for vital signs monitoring. Perform data analysis and algorithm performance testing. Support physiological data collection, dataset validation, and clinical study analysis. Collaborate with algorithm & software developers, system engineers, clinicians, and product managers. Contribute to product verification, validation, and regulatory documentation. Ensure compliance with applicable medical device standards and quality processes. Qualifications: MSc degree in biomedical engineering, engineering physics, computer science, mathematics, or a related discipline. Basic experience in algorithm development, data analysis, signal processing or AI/ML applications. Experience with Python and/or Matlab for algorithm development and data analysis. Programming skills in C/C++. Hands-on experience using AI development tools for data analysis, software development and testing. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team. Strong communication skills in English, both verbal and written. Preferred Qualifications Basic knowledge of pulse oximetry principles, signal processing, algorithm development, and performance evaluation. Familiarity with clinical study data analysis, statistical methods, and power analysis. Knowledge of international standards and EU and FDA regulation related to medical devices and their verification. We Offer You A position in a team focused on advancing state-of-the-art physiological monitoring technologies and bringing innovative solutions to clinical use. This role provides an opportunity to deepen your expertise in physiological signal processing, medical device development, and clinical validation while working alongside experienced engineers, clinicians, and researchers in a collaborative and technology-driven environment. Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. title: Fullstack Developer
snippet: 2 years experience or exceptional fresher with strong full-stack skills including React.js, Node.js, and UI/UX understanding|Build end-to-end product features from design to deployment, translate Figma designs into responsive interfaces, develop backend APIs and databases, conduct competitive analysis, and use AI tools responsibly to enhance engineering
description:
Department: Product EngineeringEmployment Type: Full-TimeExperience: 02 YearsLocation: Noida – Work from OfficeExceptional freshers with strong projects, portfolios, open-source contributions, or demonstrable engineering ability are encouraged to apply.

Build Products, Not Just Tickets

We are looking for an unusually capable early-career software engineer who wants to become a world-class product builder.You should be able to start with a product problem, competitor reference, rough workflow, wireframe, or Figma design—and help transform it into a thoughtful, polished, reliable, production-ready feature.This role combines:

  • Full-stack software engineering
  • Frontend and UI craftsmanship
  • Backend and database development
  • Product and workflow thinking
  • UI/UX understanding
  • Competitive research
  • AI-augmented development
  • Rapid learning and experimentation

You will not be limited to writing code against perfectly documented requirements. You will be expected to understand what is being built, why it matters, how leading products solve similar problems, what users may struggle with, and how the overall experience can be improved.AI should make you faster and more capable. It should not replace your judgement, fundamentals, or ownership.This is not an AI/ML research role, a passive trainee position, or a ticket-execution role. It is a high-growth engineering opportunity for someone with strong fundamentals, exceptional curiosity, and the ambition to become an outstanding full-stack product engineer.

What You Will Do

Build end-to-end product experiences

Own clearly scoped features from understanding the problem through design interpretation, development, testing, deployment, and improvement.You may work on product applications, internal platforms, customer-facing workflows, websites, dashboards, automation systems, integrations, and AI-enabled product capabilities.

Turn Figma into production-quality interfaces

Translate Figma designs and wireframes into responsive, accessible, high-performance frontend experiences.You will be expected to:

  • Build reusable components rather than one-off screens
  • Maintain design consistency across pages and workflows
  • Handle desktop, tablet, and mobile behaviour
  • Think through loading, empty, error, success, validation, permission, and edge-case states
  • Identify inconsistencies or usability gaps in the design before blindly implementing them
  • Balance visual fidelity with usability, performance, maintainability, and accessibility

Build reliable backend systems

Design and implement the backend capabilities required to support product experiences, including:

  • APIs and service logic
  • Database schemas and queries
  • Authentication and permissions
  • Validations and error handling
  • Third-party integrations
  • Background jobs and notifications
  • Logging, monitoring, and basic security controls

You should be able to understand the complete data flow—from user action in the interface to backend processing, storage, and response.

Understand the product before coding

Before implementation, understand:

  • The user’s objective
  • The business objective
  • The existing workflow
  • The desired outcome
  • Dependencies and constraints
  • Possible failure points
  • Edge cases and alternate paths

You may be required to map workflows, propose wireframes, clarify acceptance criteria, identify missing states, or recommend a simpler approach before development begins.

Conduct meaningful competitive analysis

Study how relevant products solve similar problems and identify:

  • Common workflow patterns
  • User experience conventions
  • Strengths and weaknesses
  • Missing capabilities
  • Opportunities for simplification or differentiation

Competitive analysis is not about copying another product. It is about understanding the market, learning from established patterns, and making informed product decisions.

Use AI throughout the engineering lifecycle

Use modern AI coding assistants, agents, and language models to accelerate:

  • Technical research
  • Prototyping and scaffolding
  • Code generation
  • Debugging
  • Refactoring
  • Test creation
  • Documentation
  • Code review
  • Competitive research
  • Understanding unfamiliar codebases or technologies

However, you must understand, validate, test, and take responsibility for everything you submit.We do not want engineers who copy AI-generated code without understanding it. We want engineers who use AI to explore more alternatives, learn faster, reduce repetitive work, and produce better outcomes.

Learn new technologies quickly

You may occasionally be required to work with a framework, API, library, platform, or development approach that you have not used before.You should be comfortable learning from documentation, examples, existing code, experimentation, and AI-assisted research—and converting that learning into working software.

Maintain a high engineering standard

Write code that is:

  • Clear and understandable
  • Modular and maintainable
  • Secure by design
  • Appropriately tested
  • Easy for another engineer to review
  • Consistent with the existing architecture
  • Suitable for production use

Participate constructively in code reviews and improve your work based on feedback.

What We Are Looking For

Engineering fundamentals

You should have a sound understanding of:

  • Programming fundamentals
  • Data structures and basic algorithms
  • Object-oriented and/or functional programming concepts
  • APIs and client-server architecture
  • Relational or document databases
  • Version control using Git
  • Debugging and problem isolation
  • Basic application security
  • Testing principles

We value practical understanding over memorised terminology.

Frontend capability

Hands-on experience with:

  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Responsive web development
  • A modern frontend framework such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Angular
  • Component-based development
  • API integration
  • Browser debugging and performance basics

You should care about spacing, hierarchy, typography, responsiveness, interaction states, and the overall quality of the user experience.

Backend capability

Working knowledge of at least one backend technology or ecosystem, such as:

  • Node.js
  • Python
  • Java
  • .NET

You should understand how to build APIs, work with databases, validate inputs, handle errors, structure application logic, and implement basic authentication and permissions.You do not need to be equally advanced across every layer on day one. However, you must be willing and able to work across the complete stack.

Product and UI/UX thinking

You should be able to look beyond the visible screen and think about:

  • User journeys
  • Information hierarchy
  • Workflow simplicity
  • Form behaviour
  • Navigation
  • Feedback and system states
  • Accessibility
  • Error prevention
  • Edge cases
  • Business rules

Formal design training is not required, but sensitivity to good product design is essential.

Learning ability and ownership

We are looking for someone who:

  • Learns quickly and independently
  • Asks thoughtful questions
  • Investigates before escalating
  • Can work through ambiguity
  • Does not wait passively for every detail
  • Accepts feedback without becoming defensive
  • Communicates progress and blockers clearly
  • Takes responsibility for the final outcome, not merely the code written

What Will Make You Stand Out

You will have a significant advantage if you can demonstrate one or more of the following:

  • A strong GitHub profile or product portfolio
  • A complete application that you built and deployed
  • Meaningful open-source contributions
  • Experience converting Figma designs into responsive interfaces
  • Experience designing both frontend and backend for the same feature
  • Experience with design systems or reusable component libraries
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, caching, or search
  • Experience with testing frameworks and CI/CD
  • Familiarity with Docker or cloud deployment
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or building AI-enabled product features
  • Evidence that you learned an unfamiliar technology and shipped something useful with it
  • Ability to explain technical decisions, compromises, mistakes, and lessons clearly

Certificates alone will not differentiate you. What you have built, how you think, and how quickly you learn will.

This Role May Not Be Right for You If

This position may not be suitable if you:

  • Want to work only on AI/ML models or data science notebooks
  • Want to work exclusively on frontend or exclusively on backend
  • Need complete, step-by-step instructions before beginning
  • Treat Figma as something to copy without understanding the user experience
  • Depend on AI-generated code that you cannot explain
  • Focus only on completing assigned tasks rather than improving the outcome
  • Avoid testing, documentation, code review, or feedback
  • Are uncomfortable learning unfamiliar technologies

What Success Looks Like

Within your first few weeks, you should be able to understand our engineering standards, development workflow, product context, and existing systems—and begin contributing meaningful improvements.Within the first 90 days, a successful associate engineer should be able to:

  • Independently own a reasonably scoped feature
  • Convert a design or workflow into a functional full-stack implementation
  • Identify missing requirements and edge cases before development
  • Produce clean, reviewable, appropriately tested code
  • Use AI tools productively without compromising quality
  • Communicate decisions, progress, and risks clearly
  • Demonstrate visible improvement in speed, judgement, and engineering maturity

What You Will Get

  • Real product ownership from an early stage
  • Exposure to frontend, backend, product, design, AI, and deployment
  • Opportunities to work on live products and meaningful business problems
  • Access to modern AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows
  • Mentorship and regular technical feedback
  • A high-learning environment with room to experiment
  • Career progression based on demonstrated capability and ownership—not merely tenure
  • The opportunity to grow into a strong full-stack engineer, product engineer, technical lead, or AI-enabled application engineer

description: Haluatko kehittää teknologiaa, jolla on aitoa merkitystä? Solitalla pääset rakentamaan Defence and Security (DefSec) -toimialalle digitaalisia ratkaisuja, joissa korostuvat turvallisuus, toimintavarmuus ja vaikuttavuus. Etsimme nyt tiimiimme kokenutta full-stack -kehittäjää, joka haluaa soveltaa osaamistaan vaativissa, korkean turvallisuustason ympäristöissä. Etsimme Solitalle kokeneita full-stack-ohjelmistokehittäjiä erityisesti Helsingin ja Tampereen seuduille DefSec -alueen asiakasprojekteihin. Tapauskohtaisesti sijaintisi voi olla myös muilla toimistopaikkakunnillamme (Turku, Oulu, Jyväskylä, Lahti, Pori, Kuopio, Joensuu ja Vaasa), mikäli Helsinkiin matkustaminen onnistuu tarvittaessa säännöllisesti. Pääset työskentelemään ohjelmistokehitysprojekteissa, joissa rakennetaan turvallisia, toimintavarmoja ja pitkäikäisiä digitaalisia ratkaisuja DefSec-toimialalle. Näissä hankkeissa teknologialla on suora yhteys esimerkiksi yhteiskunnan turvallisuuteen, tilannekuvan muodostamiseen, viranomaisten yhteistyöhön ja kriittisten operaatioiden sujuvuuteen. Solitalla DefSec -toimialan tekeminen kattaa esimerkiksi turvalliset digitaaliset alustat, korkean turvallisuustason operatiiviset järjestelmät, AI-pohjaisen analytiikan ja erilaiset tilannekuvaratkaisut. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa esimerkiksi operatiivisten turvallisuus- ja tilannekuvajärjestelmien kehittämistä, viranomaisyhteistyötä tukevien alustojen modernisointia, navigointiin ja autonomisiin järjestelmiin liittyviä ratkaisuja sekä tekoälyn hyödyntämisen edellytysten rakentamista korkean turvallisuustason ympäristöihin. Etsimme yhdessä projektivalikoimastamme sinulle kiinnostavan kokonaisuuden, jossa pääset yhdistämään modernin full-stack-kehityksen, konsultatiivisen työotteen ja korkean turvallisuustason vaatimukset. Millaisessa roolissa työskentelet? Ohjelmistokehittäjänä olet mukana koko kehityskaarella ideasta toteutukseen, jatkokehitykseen ja ylläpitoon asti. Suunnittelet, rakennat ja kehität turvallisia, skaalautuvia ja helposti ylläpidettäviä ohjelmistoratkaisuja asiakkaidemme tarpeisiin. DefSec-projekteissa tämä tarkoittaa usein järjestelmiä, joiden tulee toimia luotettavasti vaativissa ympäristöissä, integroitua osaksi laajempia kokonaisuuksia ja täyttää korkeat tietoturvan, toimintavarmuuden ja ylläpidettävyyden vaatimukset. Roolisi ytimessä on työskennellä teknisessä roolissa konsultatiivisella otteella: ymmärrät asiakkaan toiminnallisia ja liiketoiminnallisia tarpeita ja käännät ne fiksuiksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Arjessa työskentelet sujuvasti niin backendin kuin frontendinkin parissa. Automaatio, testaus, DevOps-ajattelu ja jatkuva toimitus ovat meillä luonnollinen osa tekemistä. Tehtävän painotukset voivat vaihdella kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan, ja rooli tarjoaa myös hyviä mahdollisuuksia kasvattaa omaa osaamista. Arjessa osallistut ominaisuuksien kehittämiseen ja suunnitteluun sekä ratkot teknisiä haasteita yhdessä tiimin kanssa. Kokeneempana kehittäjänä otat enemmän vastuuta laajemmista kokonaisuuksista, teknisestä suunnasta ja ratkaisujen laadusta, samalla tukien sekä tiimiä että asiakasta käytännön tekemisessä. Keskustelemme kanssasi roolin tarkemmista painotuksista ja vastuun laajuudesta kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Riippuen roolin kokonaisuudesta, kuukausipalkkasi sijoittuu tyypillisesti 4700-5600 euron välille. Palkka on kiinteä kuukausipalkka, ja lisäksi käytössäsi ovat Solitan kattavat luontoisedut. Millaista osaamista toivomme sinulta? Vähintään viiden vuoden työkokemusta fullstack-ohjelmistokehityksestä ja vahvaa backend-osaamista joidenkin seuraavien teknologioiden osalta: Typescript/Node.js, C#, Java. Frontend-kehityksen puolella sinulla on kokemusta moderneista frontend-teknologioista, kuten React.js tai Vue.js. Kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä on-prem ja hybridiympäristöissä. Katsomme eduksi, jos sinulla on ymmärrystä C4ISR-järjestelmistä sekä miehittämättömien järjestelmien autonomiseen ja parviohjaukseen liittyvistä ratkaisuista. Kokemusta tekoälyavusteisesta ohjelmistokehityksestä työkontekstissa, ja kiinnostusta tekoälyn tuomiin mahdollisuuksiin. Kokemusta asiakasyhteistyöstä ja kykyä ymmärtää liiketoimintatarpeita teknisten ratkaisujen taustalla. Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Kokeneemman kehittäjän roolissa odotamme myös aikaisempaa kokemusta teknisestä suunnittelusta ja kykyä ratkaista monimutkaisia teknisiä ongelmia, valmiuksia ottaa vastuuta kehityksen ohjaamisesta, arkkitehtuuriratkaisuista ja teknisestä suunnasta. Aikaisempi työkokemus turvallisuuskriittisisten järjestelmien ja korkean tietoturvan toimintaympäristöiden projekteista nähdään etuna. Solita työpaikkana Solitalla pääset työskentelemään muiden huippuasiantuntijoiden kanssa, ja vaikuttamaan työlläsi merkityksellisten DefSec -ratkaisujen kehittämiseen. Meillä työskentelet osana tiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät moderni ohjelmistokehitys, korkeat laatu- ja tietoturvavaatimukset sekä vahva yhteistyökulttuuri. Saat ympärillesi osaavia ja helposti lähestyttäviä kollegoita, ja tuemme osaamisesi kehittämistä koulutusten, sisäisten yhteisöjen ja aktiivisen tiedonjaon kautta. Kulttuurimme perustuu luottamukseen, vapauteen ja vastuullisuuteen. Kiinteä palkkamallimme tukee hyvää yhteistyötä sekä työntekijöidemme arjen tasapainoa, ja tarjoamme kattavat edut, mukaan lukien laadukkaat työvälineet, kattavan työterveyden, hyvinvointietuja, harrastekerhoja ja yhteisiä tapahtumia. Rekrytointiprosessimme koostuu kahdesta haastattelukierroksesta, joiden aikana pääset tapaamaan tiimiämme ja kuulemaan lisää työskentelystä Solitalla. Saat mahdollisuuden näyttää osaamistasi sekä esittää meille kysymyksiä. Haastatteluiden tarkoituksena on tutustua toisiimme paremmin. Jos sinulle heräsi kysyttävää, voit olla yhteydessä rekrytoijaamme Julia Oksaan ( ). Keskeisenä teknologia-, data- ja designkumppanina Solitan liiketoiminta perustuu luottamukseen ja vastuullisuuteen. Tästä syystä valitun hakijan henkilöllisyys ja työhistoria tarkistetaan. Nämä tarkastukset suoritetaan työelämän yksityisyyden suojasta annetun lain mukaisesti ja sen rajoissa. Tässä tehtävässä työskentely voi edellyttää asiakkaamme pyynnöstä tehtävää turvallisuusselvitystä. Turvallisuusselvitys toteutetaan turvallisuusselvityslain mukaisesti, ja sen hyväksytty läpäiseminen on tehtävässä työskentelyn edellytys.

description: Canonical is building a comprehensive automation suite to provide multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. The data platform team is a collaborative team that develops a full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, through NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines. We are facing the interesting problem of fault-tolerant mission-critical distributed systems and intend to deliver the world's best automation solution for delivering data platforms. We have a number of openings ranging anywhere from junior to senior level. We will help you identify a suitable position depending on your experience and interests. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of open-source community dynamics and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organisations. Location: This role can be filled in European, Middle East and African time zones. What your day will look like The data platform team is responsible for the automation of data platform operations. This includes ensuring fault-tolerant replication, TLS, installation, and much more; but also provides domain-specific expertise on the actual data system to other teams within Canonical. This role is focused on the creation and automation of features of data platforms, not analysing the data in them. Collaborate proactively with a distributed team Write high-quality, idiomatic Python code to create new features Debug issues and interact with upstream communities publicly Work with helpful and talented engineers including experts in many fields Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events What we are looking for in you Proven hands-on experience in software development using Python Proven hands-on experience in distributed systems Have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or a similar degree Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events Additional skills that you might also bring You might also bring a subset of experience from the following, which will determine the exact role and level we consider you for: Experience operating and managing data platform technologies like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, OpenSearch, Kafka, Yugabyte, Trino, Superset, Atlas, Ranger, and Redis Experience with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations Experience with the public cloud or a private cloud solution like OpenStack Experience with operating Kubernetes clusters and a belief that it can be used for serious persistent data services What we offer you Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce. In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner. Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004! Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Parental Leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’ Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business. Canonical is an equal-opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #LI-remote

description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it. This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show. What You'll Work On Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00. Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot. Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it. Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows. Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate. Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down. Who We're Looking For A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure. Your Background 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React. Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels. UI/UX practice: you design flows, prototype in Figma or similar, and run user tests. Comfortable with backend APIs and real-time transport (WebSockets, WebRTC). Accessibility and performance as habits, not afterthoughts. Nice to Have Control room, mission-critical or security interfaces. Mapping and geospatial libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl or similar). Building a design system from scratch. Defence or regulated customers. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: Would you like to become part of a highly specialized engineering team developing next-generation satellite communication technologies and software-defined radio solutions for space applications? We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes, as we deliver advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry. Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for an Advanced Software Engineer to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology. Your role in our team As our new Advanced Software Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and evolution of Terma SPECTRA, our Software Defined Radio modem and platform for satellite communications and ground-station applications. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, digital signal processing, RF systems and satellite communications, helping to design and implement advanced technologies for demanding operational environments. The position offers the opportunity to contribute across the entire software lifecycle, from requirements engineering and architecture to implementation, verification, maintenance and operational support. You will also support customers and stakeholders in the integration and operation of ground-station solutions. You will join Terma Space R&D - Power & Ground Systems in Vienna, working in a highly specialised and multidisciplinary engineering environment. The team develops advanced satellite communications and ground-system technologies, with expertise spanning software, DSP, SDR, RF, FPGA and systems engineering. The culture is collaborative, international and technically driven. How you will make a meaningful contribution Your key responsibilities include: • • Develop and evolve the Terma SPECTRA, Software Defined Radio (SDR) modem and platform for satellite communications and ground-station applications, designing and implementing advanced SATCOM and 5G-NTN algorithms, waveforms and coding schemes, including OFDM, spread-spectrum techniques, ranging and interferometry. • Drive the architecture and technical design of the SPECTRA product, contributing innovative capabilities, new product features, and conducting technical studies and investigations into emerging technologies related to RF communications, sensors and signal analysis. • Deliver high-quality software across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements engineering, analysis, architecture and design, implementation, unit testing, integration testing, system verification, maintenance and operational support, ensuring reliable and maintainable solutions for demanding satellite ground-system environments. • Collaborate across software, DSP, FPGA/CPU architectures and RF hardware domains to support effective hardware/software integration and contribute to the design and development of RF test systems, including RF-SCOE where applicable. • Support business development and innovation initiatives by contributing to proposals for new projects, technology developments and R&D activities that advance Terma's communications and satellite capabilities. • Act as a technical interface towards customers and stakeholders, supporting the development, integration and operation of ground-station systems while producing clear technical documentation and delivering software and documentation in accordance with agreed quality, schedule and project requirements. Bring your world class expertise into play You are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. German is an advantage but not a requirement. Moreover, we are also looking for a new colleague with the following qualifications: • • Degree in Software Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline, combined with relevant professional experience in software engineering and advanced communication systems. • Strong software engineering background with advanced programming skills in C, solid proficiency in C++ and Python, and hands-on development experience in GNU/Linux environments. • Proven expertise in Satellite Communications (SATCOM), Digital Signal Processing (DSP), Software Defined Radio (SDR), and digital communications, with the ability to apply complex theoretical concepts in practical solutions. • Experience with professional software development practices, including requirements-driven development, software lifecycle management, test-driven development, integration testing, and system validation. • Strong systems-level understanding across software, DSP, FPGA, and RF domains, with experience in technologies such as satellite communications, SDR, RF systems, FPGA/DSP architectures, CCSDS/ECSS standards, or advanced communication technologies including OFDM, 5G/6G, and 5G-NTN. As a person you are analytical, curious, and proactive, and takes ownership of technical challenges and approaching problems in a structured and systematic manner. You are comfortable working in multidisciplinary environments, communicate effectively with engineers, customers, and stakeholders, continuously seek to expand your knowledge, and thrive in a role that balances innovation, product evolution, and the delivery of high-performance, reliable ground-system solutions. We are an international company representing world-class expertise, delivering complex and high-tech products. We value our colleagues and our meaningful contributions to securing people through advanced technology. You will also experience that we have a strong focus on your development, teaching you useful new competences and further strengthening current ones, both professionally and personally. Our company culture is autonomous and engaging, and we acknowledge the importance of flexibility in a great working environment. When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience: Great people, challenging tasks, world-class expertise, and meaningful contribution in your daily work. Location and starting date This is a full-time position to be located at Terma’s premises in Vienna, Austria or Darmstadt, Germany starting ASAP. Benefits at Terma At Terma, we prioritize the well-being of our employees, ensuring they are well taken care of. Joining our team comes with a multitude of perks designed to enhance your social life, cultural experiences, and health. • • Excellent workplace atmosphere in a multicultural, dynamic and inspiring team • Structured onboarding and buddy program, along with ongoing opportunities for professional and personal development • Flexible working hours model (flextime, up to 40% work from home address in Vienna possible, additional days off) • Diverse benefits such as subsidized on-site restaurant, fruit basket, free beverages (coffee, tea, hot chocolate), discount vouchers, health initiatives, financial contributions toward selected personal and health-related expenses, employer-sponsored pension plan as well as team events and company celebrations • Good public transport connections and on-site parking options The base pay is composed of the amount according to the Collective Agreement of the Austrian Electrical and Electronics Industry which is at least EUR 3.888,53 gross per month (x 14) and an overpayment depending on your qualifications and experience. We are dedicated to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. Our commitment to DEIB (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging) means we actively value and celebrate unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We strive to create an environment where all employees have equal opportunities to succeed, feel respected and valued, and experience a true sense of belonging. To support an unbiased evaluation process, we kindly encourage applicants to omit personal details such as photos and age from their applications. If you would like to take on the challenge of working in an innovative company, we look forward to receiving your application. A resume is required, while a cover letter is optional. To ensure that your application will reach us and is properly processed, we only accept applications via www.terma.com. Applications will be processed continuously. Do you have any questions regarding the position? For further information, please contact Ms. Silvia Cavallini by telephone [+49 6151 860050] or by email [ta.space@terma.com]. Location of position: • Vienna, Austria • Darmstadt, Germany Terma group has headquarters in Denmark and is a high-tech company developing products and systems for defense and non-defense security applications, including command and control systems, radar systems, self-protection systems for aircraft, space technology, and aerostructures for the aircraft industry. TERMA | Allies in innovation

description: We build the technology that transforms how mid-market businesses operate, real products, real AI, real ROI. We're deliberately lean, and we deliver like a team three times our size because of *how* we work, not how many of us there are. This isn't a role for someone who wants tickets handed to them. Read on only if that appeals. **What you'll actually do** You'll own problems end-to-end, from a client conversation to something shipped and working in production. You'll design, build, and be accountable for the outcome, not just the code. You'll use AI as a genuine multiplier: to move fast on the 80% and reserve your judgment for the 20% that decides whether the result is any good. And you'll be expected to make StepInsight better, to spot the process that's dumb, the tool we're missing, the thing nobody's questioning. **Who this is for** - You take ownership. When something's broken or unclear, you drive it to resolution instead of waiting to be told. - You're already living in the new way of building. AI hasn't threatened you, you've absorbed it, you know where it's brilliant and where it quietly fails, and you catch the lies. - You ask the questions everyone else skipped. You'd rather challenge a bad brief than build it perfectly. - You learn on your own initiative, because you can't help it, not because someone put it on a development plan. - You want to help build a company, not just collect a salary. **Who this is not for** If you need detailed specs before you can start, prefer to stay in your lane, ship AI output you can't fully explain, or want a big-company machine to hide inside, we'll both be happier if you don't apply. No hard feelings. **The real talk** We've been around for 10 years, we’re a growing consultancy, not a polished corporate. The work is ambiguous, the client problems are genuinely hard, and you'll wear more than one hat. That's the trade off for real ownership and moving fast without red tape. If that sounds like a downside, it isn't the place for you. If it sounds like oxygen, keep reading. **Requirements** - Solid experience in most of the core web development technologies, including Angular and Firebase, is required. - Experience building RESTful APIs with NestJS and TypeScript. - Experience designing and managing SQL database - MySQL, MSSQL or other relational database experience. - Experience using automated build and deployment systems such as GitHub, BitBucket. - Experience in other frameworks or languages is welcome. - A minimum of 1-2 years of software development experience is required for this position. **How to apply** Skip the cover letter. Apply through our portal, where you'll upload your CV and take on a short OSINT challenge - a puzzle, not a personality quiz. It's the same kind of resourceful, get-to-the-bottom-of-it thinking the job runs on, and it's genuinely good fun. Apply here: https://career.stepinsight.com/apply/software-developer-sydney-hzab?src=wellfound
