description: Overview Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. The Opportunity This position is part of the Channel Emulation & Modeling Solutions team, which develops channel-modeling capabilities and test solutions for advanced wireless systems. The 6G Channel Emulation Solution Engineer contributes to the development of channel models and related test solution functionality for terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks, integrated sensing and communication, massive MIMO and other emerging wireless technologies. Responsibilities 6G Channel Modeling and Feature Definition Develop channel-modeling methods and test-solution concepts for emerging 6G wireless technologies in conducted and OTA chamber test environments. Translate standards, research results, customer use cases, and system-level needs into clear feature breakdowns, engineering requirements, and implementation specifications. Define model parameters, scenario behavior, interfaces, expected outputs, acceptance criteria, and traceable test cases for channel-modeling applications. Solution Development and Integration Contribute to 6G channel-modeling solution development across use cases such as NTN, sensing, and massive MIMO. Specify functional requirements and feature breakdowns for software development and contribute to implementation, verification, and results analysis. Support test-solution integration and development for conducted and OTA channel-emulation use cases. Apply channel-modeling theory to practical product, test, and customer requirements. Collaborate with software, system, research, standards, and customer-facing teams throughout the solution-development lifecycle. Qualifications Master's or doctoral degree in electrical engineering, telecommunications, signal processing, applied physics, or a related field. Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience in wireless channel modeling, system simulation, channel emulation, OTA testing, or related wireless R&D. Strong understanding of radio propagation and channel-modeling theory, including multipath, fading, Doppler, delay, angular characteristics, MIMO, and antenna concepts. Experience in wireless channel modeling, system simulation, channel emulation, OTA testing, or related wireless R&D. Ability to translate advanced technical concepts into clear software requirements, model definitions, and test cases. Experience with numerical modeling and data analysis using tools such as MATLAB or Python. Knowledge of 3GPP channel models, NTN, ISAC, massive MIMO, or OTA methodologies is an advantage. Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in an international R&D environment. Why Keysight You will work with experts in channel modeling, channel emulation, RF measurement, and OTA testing while contributing to technologies and test concepts that enable the transition toward 6G. We’re two repeat operators obsessed with building a “super-powered” sidekick for small business owners that orchestrates their tools and monitors their data to not only automate existing tasks, but change them and even come up with entirely new ones: **let ordinary people create extraordinary outcomes**. (alternatively: "Imagine Tony Stark's suit, just anyone gets to use one. Superpowers without the capes." We've just raised our pre-seed round, hired a founding engineer and now we’re now looking for **two founding engineers** to make the team 5 in total. ### The role As a Founding Engineer at Super44 you will: Ship end-to-end: napkin sketch → prototype → live with real merchants in half a day. - Build multi-agent, multi-model, multimodal systems that feel like magic and don’t break. - Jump across the stack: product, backend, AI agents, data pipelines and infra. - Working with rich business data, smart context management, and combining APIs and datasets to provide insights that drive real action (e.g. “boost revenue by 5% through smart pricing”). - Co-create our engineering culture: tech stack, tooling, quality bar, and how we ship. This is not a “feature team” role. You’ll be building core product and company, side by side with us. ### You might be a fit if… - You’re **high-horsepower** – you think from first principles, learn fast and like hard problems. - You’ve **built real things** end-to-end before, ideally in your own project or an early-stage startup. - You can go **full-stack** (or close): backend, some frontend, AI/automation – whatever it takes to ship. - You love **vibe coding** and rapid iteration, but still know when real engineering rigor matters. - You’re **energized by ambiguity** and the “no playbook yet” phase. - You’re up for working **really hard on something that matters**, with people you genuinely like. - You want a **tight-knit crew** where every team member really matters ### What we offer - **Day 0 impact**: Be #2/#3 employee of a startup with the ambition to become the operating system for millions of local business around the world - **Competitive salary *and* competitive equity** – we don’t want anyone joining us to choose between the two. Location: **Cologne–Bonn** region, building together in person. We have Superhouse, a hackerhouse overlooking the Rhein if you need accommodation. ### How we work We’re in full builder mode: working all the time we reasonably can, but focused on sustainable intensity. We like to: - Cut to the chase and always assume good intent. - Have strong opinions loosely held - Push each other to new heights and offer support along the way If this sounds like you, send us a short note about something you’ve built that you’re proud of (including links/github if you can). We’d love to meet you.

description: As the publisher of Ubuntu we serve millions of developers, building for the cloud, IoT and data science. We aim to make open source easier and more reliable for innovators and enterprises. We have created a new Developer Relations team to engage directly with open source communities and developer-centric organisations. We hope both to communicate our vision and products for better open source development experiences, and also to have a better feedback loop from those audiences to shape our offerings and priorities. A Developer Relations Engineer is a technical expert, strategist and communicator with deep empathy for developers. This discipline combines practical engineering skills with firm diplomacy across organisational boundaries, in both directions. Like our audience, a Developer Relations Engineer is never satisfied with the status quo, and is driven by an insatiable curiosity to find better ways to get things done. They are problem-solvers and inventors, who understand people's needs and love the way that tools can be adapted to meet them. They stay current with tech trends and provide insights and guidance while fostering innovation. To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical . Location : we are building our initial DevRel team in Europe, Middle East, African and American time zones What your day will look like In a typical day, a developer relations engineer might: take part in team product meetings, at levels from strategy to day-by-day development progress, contributing insight and expertise maintain conversations with developer community members wherever they may be found - IRC, social media, product forums, meet-ups and more work with colleagues in other teams in the company, as part of efforts to help establish commonality and consistent approaches help solve specific technical problems that users or colleagues have identified contribute to technical documentation to ensure that developer users' needs are met there work on technical articles, presentations or workshops identify new opportunities and directions for improvement in the developer experience we provide present at conferences, meetups or technical events What we are looking for in you A strong candidate is a programmer or developer with a demonstrable passion for and engagement in open-source software has worked with real-world challenges developing and deploying software using Linux has practical hands-on experience of Linux software packaging (including Snaps, debs, charms, rocks, PIP, containers) understands current software packing issues and trends in the Linux ecosystem has been a contributor to open-source communities, software and documentation is an engaging, vivacious speaker and presenter can work effectively, tactfully, empathetically and confidently in contexts where different parties have different perspectives, needs and understanding builds trust, relationships and confidence is willing to travel globally twice a year for company events, as well as to upstream and partner events Additional skills that you might also bring previous experience in a developer advocacy or community role in-depth familiarity with Ubuntu and the Canonical ecosystem of products What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004! Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #LI-remote

snippet: **Who we are** At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. description: **Who we are** At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit [www.domino.ai](http://www.domino.ai) **What we are building** The Customer Engineering Solutions Team at Domino is the primary delivery engine that sits inside the walls of the world’s most regulated and demanding organizations, including Fortune 100 pharmaceutical and life sciences leaders. A Forward Deployed Engineer is a software engineer with solutions instincts, embedded in a customer's environment, building AI workflows on Domino that the customer couldn't have built as fast, or as well, without you. We write production code, ship it inside the customer's environment, and stay until Domino is fundamentally part of how they work. In the Life Sciences vertical, we build and deploy production-grade AI solutions that solve real, high-impact use cases, ranging from specialized AI inferencing workflows, custom cloud and data integrations, and interactive applications, to frontier solutions around Statistical Computing Environments (SCE), clinical CRM, etc. Our work provides the ultimate proof point that Domino is a comprehensive AI business solutions platform. **What your impact will be** In your first year, your impact will unfold across key milestones as you take ownership of strategic life sciences accounts: - **Day 0–30 (Onboard & Shadow):** You will be given the resources to master Domino platform mechanics and learn core user/admin functionalities. You will closely shadow the customer’s environment, pairing with a senior FDE to learn the client’s unique data, tooling stack, and commercial objectives. - **By Month 6 (Full Ownership):** You will step into full customer ownership across your engagements, executing independently against a prioritized backlog managed by your partner Engagement Manager (EM). You will build and deploy production-grade solutions across the entire MLOps lifecycle (development, deployment, and monitoring) while actively advising data science teams on Domino best practices. - **By Year 1 (Strategic Scale & Leverage):** You will lead and advise on key accounts, serving as a trusted advisor to technical and business stakeholders alike. You will author reusable playbooks, integration templates, and deployment guides for our shared knowledge base, measurably lifting the delivery speed of the entire FDE practice. Additionally, you will translate field intelligence into critical product feedback, routing platform signals to our SRE, Support, and Product teams to shape Domino’s roadmap. **What we look for in this role** - We are looking for a sharp, action-first engineer who possesses a unique blend of deep technical grit and customer empathy. - **Core Technical Stack:** Strong engineering roots with deep proficiency in Python (primary), alongside familiarity with SQL, R, and Bash. - **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Experience with Kubernetes and managed K8s solutions (such as EKS, AKS, or GKE), Docker, and cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP). You should be capable of troubleshooting networking, compute, and platform issues. - **AI & MLOps Experience:** A proven track record of delivering machine learning workflows, model deployment/monitoring, GPU workloads, and generative AI or agent frameworks. - **Regulated Environment Navigation:** Experience operating within, or consulting for, highly regulated or constrained environments. You can expertly navigate multi-factor constraints like strict compliance rules, data security hurdles, and infrastructure limits. - **Consultative Mindset:** Exceptional communication skills across both technical and business audiences. You are comfortable running structured discovery conversations, leading technical solutioning sessions, and translating messy customer requirements into buildable, tested solutions. - **Execution Style:** An "act fast, own it" mentality. You thrive in ambiguity, do not let blockers sit, and are comfortable making yourself productive inside an unfamiliar codebase quickly. **What we value** - We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply - We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success - We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work - We value all of you that believe improving is always possible. At Domino, everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything - We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company * * * #LI-Remote

title: Electronics Engineering Intern
snippet:
We are looking for an enthusiastic Electronics Engineering Intern to gain hands-on experience designing, building, testing, and debugging electronic hardware. Working alongside senior engineers, you’ll contribute across the development cycle—from schematic and PCB design through prototyping, testing, debugging, and documentation.

Responsibilities and Duties
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic Electronics Engineering Intern to gain hands-on experience designing, building, testing, and debugging electronic hardware. Working alongside senior engineers, you’ll contribute across the development cycle—from schematic and PCB design through prototyping, testing, debugging, and documentation.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Build, assemble, test, and debug prototype circuits and PCB assemblies.
  • Assist with schematic capture and PCB design.
  • Use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and signal generators for testing and troubleshooting.
  • Support soldering, rework, and other hands-on laboratory activities.
  • Develop and test firmware for microcontrollers and embedded systems.
  • Analyse test results and document designs, tests, and project progress.
  • Work with senior engineers to troubleshoot technical issues and improve hardware performance.
  • Follow engineering and laboratory safety procedures.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related field.
  • Understanding of analog and digital circuit design.
  • Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium, KiCad, or Eagle.
  • Hands-on experience with electronics lab equipment and basic soldering.
  • Programming experience in C, C++, Python, or similar.
  • Familiarity with STM32, ESP32, Arduino, or other microcontrollers.
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as I²C, SPI, UART, CAN, or USB is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Hands-on experience through university, robotics, or personal electronics projects is highly valued.
  • EU citizenship required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Car parking
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

description: **About Us** Briidge.one is a custom AI and software transformation company helping established businesses turn fragmented operations, legacy systems and proprietary data into intelligent digital infrastructure. We work with businesses that have outgrown generic SaaS tools and need technology built around the way they actually operate. **Our work includes:** * Custom AI powered business systems * Internal operational platforms and dashboards * Client portals and visibility systems * AI reporting and query assistants * CRM, ERP, project management and workflow integrations * Legacy system modernization and digital transformation * Custom software infrastructure built around proprietary business data We typically work on high value transformation projects ranging from $20K–$100K+, working directly with founders, CEOs, partners and senior decision makers. We are now expanding our presence across high value industries including Private Equity, Law, Real Estate, Investment Firms, Professional Services and other established businesses. **The Role** We are looking for a Full Cycle Sales Executive / Business Development Partner who can own the entire sales process from first contact to closed deal. This is not a traditional SDR role where your responsibility ends after booking a meeting. You will be responsible for identifying the right accounts, initiating conversations, qualifying opportunities, running discovery calls, understanding business problems, positioning Briidge.one's solutions, preparing proposals, handling objections, negotiating with decision-makers, and ultimately closing the deal. You will work closely with the founding team but we are looking for someone who can eventually operate as the owner of their sales pipeline and revenue targets. If you can sell complex, high ticket B2B solutions and are comfortable speaking with CEOs, founders, partners and senior executives, this role is for you. **What You'll Own** 1. Prospecting & Account Research * Identify high value companies that have a genuine need for AI, automation, software modernization or digital transformation. * Research companies, their technology stack, business model, operational challenges and key decision makers. * Build targeted account and prospect lists using tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Crunchbase and other intelligence platforms. * Identify the right stakeholders CEOs, Founders, Partners, COOs, CTOs, CIOs, Managing Directors and other senior decision makers. 2. Outbound Sales * Develop and execute highly personalized outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, calls, and other relevant channels. * Craft messaging around business outcomes, operational inefficiencies, revenue opportunities, cost reduction, and competitive advantage not generic software features. * Create multiple touchpoints and follow ups throughout the sales cycle. * Continuously test and improve messaging, targeting and outreach strategies. 3. Discovery & Qualification * Conduct discovery calls with qualified prospects. * Understand the prospect's current workflows, technology infrastructure, operational bottlenecks and business objectives. * Identify whether there is a genuine business case for custom software or AI transformation. * Qualify opportunities based on budget, authority, need, timing and strategic fit. * Translate complex business problems into clear opportunities for Briidge.one. 4. Solution Selling * Work with the founding/product team to develop the right solution for each qualified opportunity. * Clearly communicate how Briidge.one can solve the prospect's business problem. * Position custom software and AI as a business investment rather than simply a technology expense. * Build compelling business cases around ROI, efficiency, visibility, automation, scalability and revenue impact. 5. Proposal & Deal Management * Own the opportunity from discovery through proposal. * Coordinate with the internal team to develop proposals, scopes, and commercial structures. * Present proposals directly to decision makers. * Handle objections around pricing, implementation, risk, timelines and internal adoption. * Manage stakeholders throughout the buying process. * Keep opportunities moving forward and prevent deals from going cold. 6. Negotiation & Closing * Lead commercial conversations and negotiations. * Understand procurement and decision making processes within larger organizations. * Create urgency without using aggressive or transactional sales tactics. * Negotiate confidently while protecting deal value and margins. * Take ownership of getting qualified opportunities across the finish line. 7. CRM & Pipeline Management * Maintain a clean and accurate CRM. * Track every opportunity, interaction, next step and stakeholder. * Maintain accurate sales forecasts. * Build and manage your own pipeline. * Report weekly on pipeline value, conversion rates, sales activity, deal stages and revenue generated. **What We’re Looking For** * 3+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably selling software, technology, AI, digital transformation, consulting or other high ticket services. * Experience in managing a full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. * Experience selling to founders, CEOs, C-suite executives, partners, or senior decision-makers. * Experience selling deals in the $20K+ range is strongly preferred. * Experience selling into Western markets. Particularly the US, UK, Europe, Canada or Australia. * Capability: The ability to understand complex custom software services and translate them into dead simple, compelling value propositions for non tech clients. **Why Join Us? (The Offer)** * High Ticket Sales- Work on projects typically ranging from $20K–$100K+, with the opportunity to earn meaningful commissions on revenue you generate. * Full Ownership- Own the entire sales cycle instead of being restricted to one stage of the funnel. * Direct Access to Founders- Work directly with the founding team and have a meaningful influence on Briidge.one's growth strategy. * Sell Something Custom- You're not selling another generic SaaS subscription. You're selling technology designed around a company's actual operations, data, and business objectives. * Total Flexibility: A remote first culture with completely flexible working hours. * A highly attractive commission structure tied directly to closed revenue, with additional earning potential through recurring retainers and account expansion. **Ideal Candidate** You're probably a great fit if you are someone who: * Can find your own opportunities. * Isn't afraid of cold outreach. * Enjoys talking to senior executives. * Can run a discovery call without a script. * Understands how businesses make purchasing decisions. * Can sell complex services without oversimplifying them. * Is comfortable with $20K–$100K+ conversations. * Can negotiate without immediately discounting. * Takes ownership when a deal gets stuck. * Measures success by revenue, not activity. * Wants to build something rather than simply work a sales job. If you know how to turn conversations into contracts, we want to hear from you.

description: AIを使って開発速度を上げ、顧客課題に直結するプロダクトを作りたい。そんなエンジニアに向けた募集です。 【募集背景】 AI時代の開発では、要件定義から実装、改善までの速度が競争力になります。SALT2では、デモ、PoC、本開発を顧客課題に合わせて高速に進めます。 【任せたい仕事】 任せるのは、AIプロダクト、業務アプリ、Agentic AI、社内モジュールの開発です。 具体的には、以下のような仕事を任せます。 ・LLM/Agentアプリ開発 ・業務アプリ開発 ・デモ・PoC実装 ・API連携 ・既存コード改善 ・開発モジュール化 ・顧客課題に応じた技術検証 ChatGPT、Claude、Claude Code、Codex、CursorなどのAIツールは、全職種で使う前提です。調査、資料作成、開発、分析、議事録、業務改善をAI-nativeに進め、短い時間で高い品質のアウトプットを出すことを求めます。 【身につくスキル・経験】 AI-nativeな開発と顧客価値への接続を同時に経験できます。 ・AI-nativeな開発力 ・デモから本開発まで作る力 ・顧客課題を要件に落とす力 ・高速プロトタイピング ・再利用可能な設計力 【サポートについて】 未経験領域があっても問題ありません。最初は既存資料、過去事例、社内レビューを使いながら、必要な知識と進め方をキャッチアップします。 ただし、用意されているのは受け身で学ぶだけの環境ではありません。分からないことは自分で調べる。必要ならすぐに聞く。AIを使って初稿を作る。レビューを受けて直す。このサイクルを高速で回せる人に向いています。 【入社後の立ち上がり】 最初は既存コードと案件理解から入り、約1ヶ月で機能開発やデモを担当します。約2ヶ月以降は、PoCや本開発の一部を主導します。 【こんな人と働きたい】 ・AIを使って開発速度を上げたい人 ・顧客価値に近い開発がしたい人 ・小さいチームで裁量を持ちたい人 ・PMやコンサルとも会話したい人 ・最後まで作り切れる人 【SALT2で働く魅力】 SALT2は、AIを触るだけの会社ではありません。顧客の業務に入り、課題を見立て、提案し、開発し、導入後の改善まで前に進めるチームです。 Boost Consultingとの距離も近く、元ヤフー代表取締役社長CEOの小澤隆生さん、マッキンゼーやPEファンドMBKパートナーズ出身の高橋健太さんをはじめ、企業立ち上げや経営に近いメンバーから学べます。PM、AIコンサル、BizDevとして、事業を小さいところから立ち上げる感覚を持ちながら働ける環境です。 若いチームだからこそ、手を挙げれば任されます。一方で、経験豊富なメンバーと一緒に実務に入れるため、独学だけでは得られない視点も身につきます。 【働き方】 オンライン面談も可能です。 【最後に】 AI-nativeな開発で、顧客に届くものを作りたい方は、ぜひ話しましょう。

description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact. Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible. What you will do: Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions. Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies. Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers. Requirements Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United Kingdom. There is a preference for candidates to be based in London, with the option to work out of our office. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. description: At ExtraHop , we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. Position Summary At ExtraHop, we're on a mission to help organizations achieve complete visibility, real-time threat detection, and proactive security through cutting-edge network detection and response (NDR) technology. Our NDR product is a market leader, providing our customers with the ability to detect, investigate, and respond to threats faster than ever before. We’re proud of the work we do and the recognition we’ve received, including our recent Gartner Peer Insights award, which reflects the trust and satisfaction our customers have in our solutions. If you're passionate about innovation, dedicated to protecting digital infrastructures, and ready to make a real impact, we invite you to join our team and help us shape the future of cybersecurity. Do you want to work with a platform and technology where you can help customers solve critical business problems? Do you enjoy and excel at building lasting customer relationships? As a member of our Customer Success team, you’ll have the opportunity to unleash your expertise to wow customers and make a difference in an exciting, growing company. At ExtraHop, we provide solutions for mission-critical business and technology problems across a vast array of industries and technologies. With us, you’ll deliver solutions that customers previously thought infeasible or impossible to solve. Join us and you’ll find we have a supportive home team, great customers, and a product that customers love. Key Responsibilities The ExtraHop Customer Success team focuses on successful outcomes for our customers. As a Technical Customer Success Manager, you will play a leading role in accomplishing the following goals: Analyze customer requirements and promote the highest value application of ExtraHop in our customer's business environment. Secure contract renewals and identify growth opportunities by assisting customers in driving successful outcomes with ExtraHop products and services. Engage ExtraHop end-users to provide targeted assistance and enablement - both FTF and remote customers. Assist in assessing customer needs and coordinate high-value services such as ExtraHop Professional Services and advanced training. Lead and facilitate new customer’s initial onboarding and introduction to ExtraHop. Assess and document customer health and maturity levels to improve customer engagement strategy. Execute direct customer engagement workflows and automated processes to evangelize ExtraHop and engage a wide cross-section of our user community. Partner closely with the local account team to align customer strategic goals with technical execution, driving continuous product adoption and account expansion. Assist and contribute to ExtraHop’s Voice of Customer activities and provide influential input on product and service roadmap priorities. Work with a diverse cross-section of ExtraHop’s business units and represent customer needs and expectations. Champion customer needs and opportunities for product enhancement with ExtraHop development teams. Develop and maintain Customer Success Plans documenting customer’s desired outcomes and value expectations. Promote customers' use of our community platform and self-service capabilities. Develop deep customer relationships across the customer organizations with key stakeholders and technology leaders. Recognize organic opportunities for expansion/growth and engage the Sales team to pursue. Host and conduct recurring customer meetings, working sessions, and Business Reviews with customers. Operate as the nexus for customer engagement and strategy with other ExtraHop teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, and Support. Delivers hybrid customer engagement through a balanced mix of remote collaboration and in-person meetings, with occasional travel as required. Required Qualifications We’re looking for a seasoned Customer Success Manager who can help us grow to the next level as a company. As a starting point for this position, you’ll need the following background: Four-year college degree, preferably in a technical field such as management information systems or information technology. Skills and Competencies Work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders. Effective communication skills, both verbal and written. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated ability to work flexibly, both with independent initiative and judgment as well as execute established Customer Success programs consistently and accurately. Proficiency of networking principles (layers 2 through 4 of the OSI model) and application protocols (e.g., HTTP, CIFS,, DB Protocols such as TNS/TDS, MS-RPC, and DNS). Technical proficiency in enterprise networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing/switching, network packet brokers, firewalls) and API integrations for security stack interoperability. Experience with enterprise security operations, including Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows and Incident Response (IR) protocols. Hands-on familiarity with firewalls, SIEM/SOAR integrations, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/XDR), Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIP), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and architectures. Experience in major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), virtualization, and containerization concepts. Experience with project management is a plus. Proficient user of Salesforce.com CRM or similar. Intermediate-level skills with Microsoft Excel, familiar with formulas and basic data manipulation & analysis. ABOUT EXTRAHOP ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise. OUR VALUES Our culture is rooted in our five Values . These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues. Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done. Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo. Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. BENEFITS Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits: Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable Educational Reimbursement 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable Pet Insurance (US Only) Parental Leave (US Only) Hybrid and Remote Work Model Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today! To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn . Create a Job Alert Interested in building your career at ExtraHop? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.

description: ### **Your Mission** As a (Key) Business Developer for the Indian market, your mission is to identify, acquire and grow high-potential sellers within the jewellery, gemstones and diamonds categories. You will play a critical role in expanding Catawiki’s presence in the Indian market by building a strong seller network and creating long-term commercial partnerships. You will focus on developing new business opportunities, establishing relationships with key industry players and delivering a seamless onboarding experience for new sellers. Working closely with Experts, Category Managers and Account Managers, you will combine commercial instinct, relationship building and market expertise to grow a high-quality seller portfolio in one of our most strategic growth markets. **What You'll Do** - **Drive seller acquisition** by identifying, prospecting and developing high-potential leads through calls, email outreach, field visits, trade fairs and expert collaboration. - **Build strategic seller relationships** by onboarding and nurturing new and existing jewellery, gemstones and diamonds sellers in the Indian market. - **Create long-term growth opportunities** by developing commercial growth plans together with Account Managers, Experts and Category Managers. - **Use data to unlock seller potential** by analysing seller performance and identifying opportunities to improve KPIs such as lot submissions, average lot value and sell-through rate. - **Deliver an exceptional seller experience** by ensuring a frictionless onboarding journey and acting as a trusted commercial advisor throughout the seller lifecycle. - **Support market expansion initiatives** by identifying partnership opportunities, educating sellers on buyer demand and category trends, and strengthening Catawiki’s position in the Indian luxury market. ### **What You'll Bring** - **Commercial sales or account management experience** with a proven ability to drive growth and build strong client relationships. - **Industry expertise** in jewellery, gemstones, diamonds or luxury categories within the Indian market. - **Strong relationship-building skills** with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders across different levels. - **Analytical and data-driven mindset** with the ability to translate insights into actionable commercial strategies. - **Excellent negotiation and communication skills** across phone, email, in-person meetings and cross-functional collaboration. - **Entrepreneurial and autonomous approach** with strong organisational and prioritisation skills. - **Experience using CRM and sales tooling**, with HubSpot experience considered a plus. - **Passion for special objects and e-commerce** with curiosity about the luxury market. **Where You’ll Be** This role is based in India (ideally in Jaipur) with a work-from-home arrangement. You will be part of the Luxury cluster and will focus on the Indian jewellery, gemstones and diamonds market.

description: Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy: communications, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations at scale. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our technologies, and our solutions power many of the interceptor operations active today. Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage. Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere. We build resilient communication, navigation, and coordination systems for the age of autonomy. We are looking for a Hardware Engineer to join our engineering team in Tampere. In this role you will take ownership of hardware design end-to-end from schematics and PCB layout through prototyping, validation, and production building the physical systems that power next-generation drone communication and navigation technology. Working closely with our low-level software team, you'll help bring reliable, mission-critical hardware from concept to real-world deployment. Key responsibilities Design, develop, and review schematics, PCBs and their sub-components. Research on hardware components that could be used to solve business problems. Generate PCB manufacturing documents. Participating in product and prototype development. Verify and validate HW designs. Co-operate with low-level software developers. Document technical solutions. Debug and analyze HW and production issues. Be responsible for the entire HW product development lifecycle. What we require To be successful in this role you should have: Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. A solid understanding of principles of analog/digital electronics. Able to design the complex PCB projects. Understanding of the full device manufacturing cycle. Hands-on experience with lab measurements with modern equipment. Knowledge of EMI/ESD protection principles. Experience with modern SI/PI simulation tools. Experience with Altium Designer Strong debugging and troubleshooting abilities, analytical skills. Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar project management and requirements management tools. Experience working in a global work environment. Fluent written and spoken English. What we see as a plus Understanding of RF design. Experience with EMI simulation tools. High-speed digital circuits design. PCB development with FPGA. DDR3/4/5 design experience. CE, FCC and RED certification understanding. Location Tampere (on-site), full-time, permanent position. What we offer Paid Time Off The Employee is entitled to an annual holiday 4 + 1 weeks from the first day Health & Wellness Package Lunch Benefit: daily lunch allowance up to the tax‑free limit as a fringe benefit. Sport & Culture: annual budget for gyms, sports activities, cultural events, and hobbies. Wellbeing Allowance: additional allowance for massage, mental health services, and other wellness support. Extended Occupational Healthcare: enhanced coverage including partial dental care. Accident Insurance (24/7): full coverage for accidents during both work and free time. Business Travel Insurance: coverage for work‑related travel. Snacks & Office Comforts: coffee, snacks, fruits and other office perks. Work Model Flexible Working Hours: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00. No‑Crunch Policy: no systematic overtime; overtime is compensated or reimbursed. Meeting‑Light Culture: protected focus time and minimal unnecessary meetings. Growth & Innovation High‑End Equipment: premium laptop, monitor, and peripherals. Lab & Gadget Budget: annual budget for hardware, tools, books, and learning materials. Hackathons & Offsites: regular internal events focused on innovation and technology. Travel & Mobility Business Travel Expenses: full coverage of tickets, accommodation, and transportation. Per Diem (Vero Max): daily allowances according to the maximum tax‑free Vero rates. Impact & Culture Low‑hierarchy, engineering‑driven environment with strong autonomy and zero micromanagement. Culture Statement Don’t meet every requirement? Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Sine Engineering, we value authenticity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t perfectly match every listed requirement. You might be the ideal candidate for this role- or for another opportunity with us. Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of UAV technology. Privacy Notice By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes. Your data will be handled in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Finnish Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. We will retain your application data for up to 2 years, unless you consent to a longer retention period. You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting: privacy@sineeng.com

description: Hi, I'm Robin. I'm building a company to design and manufacture industrial machinery (robots) to automate labor intensive processes in factories. We look for interesting opportunities for tasks in factories that can be automated, meet business owners that run those factories to learn as much about the process as possible and to turn them into future customers, and then we go back to our office to do our thing. Our thing is to design and build a machine from scratch. So that's brainstorming, CAD, software, assembling hardware, electronics, problem solving, more problem solving, and delivering the machine to customers. We have a 3D printer, lasercutter, plenty of other tools and a fairly large office/workspace in Amsterdam Sloterdijk. I like to design proper stuff, high quality. We want to build things that we are proud of. Things the customer will have as few issues with as possible. Things that will still work 10 years from now. We don't need to be icky about saving every possible cent. Of course there will be plenty of mistakes and redesigns, that's all part of the process, and that's okay. I'm funding this off of my savings, so I can't really pay you. But of course, you'd get your fair share of future earnings. Do you lose track of time in enthusiasm to build and develop stuff? Do you enjoy the mental game of finding the best solution for problems? If this sounds like something you'd enjoy being part of, send me a message! contact@zuttec.com, or let's just chat/meet up. I've got far more ideas than I have time for, so I'm sure there'll be plenty to do :) Cheers, Robin

description: Senior Process Engineer (Biomass Gasification) Company: Carbon Negative Power Location: Remote (with significant travel to project sites required) Job Type: Full-Time About Us At Carbon Negative Power, we partner with agricultural producers in the timber, plywood, and rice milling sectors to transform their biomass waste into a permanent economic advantage. We design, build, and operate custom on-site power plants that deliver reliable behind-the-meter baseload electricity at zero upfront cost to the producer. Our facilities convert organic residues into clean energy, biochar, and high-value carbon credits. We take on the engineering and capital risk so our partners can focus on their core business of agricultural production. The Role We are seeking an experienced Process Engineer with deep expertise in biomass gasification to lead the technical deployment of our carbon-negative energy facilities. This is a hybrid role. You will work remotely on process design and engineering while traveling to agricultural and industrial sites to supervise installations, oversee commissioning, and ensure operational excellence. Key Responsibilities Lead the process design and optimization for biomass gasification systems operating at core temperatures of 700°C. Travel to project sites to supervise the installation, integration, and commissioning of new power plants. Develop and refine mass and energy balances, Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), and Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) for facilities processing agricultural waste like rice husks, corn waste, and plywood residue. Serve as the primary technical lead on the ground during the build phase, ensuring construction aligns with strict engineering specifications and safety standards. Troubleshoot process bottlenecks during site startups and transition plants into smooth, continuous operation for behind-the-meter electricity generation. Collaborate closely with internal project teams and on-site agricultural partners to ensure seamless facility integration. About You Education: Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a closely related technical field. Experience: Proven track record in process engineering with specific, hands-on experience in biomass gasification and thermal energy systems. Field Readiness: Highly comfortable transitioning from remote design work to hands-on site supervision. You must be willing to travel extensively to agricultural production sites for installations and commissioning. Technical Acumen: Strong proficiency in calculating mass and energy balances and developing technical diagrams for waste-to-energy pathways. Problem Solver: Ability to make critical engineering decisions on-site to keep construction and commissioning on schedule. Why Join Us? You will be at the forefront of decarbonizing heavy agriculture. This role offers the autonomy of remote work combined with the tangible satisfaction of building and commissioning physical infrastructure that eliminates energy costs for producers and removes carbon from the atmosphere. title: Jr Engineer - Construction

description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for a Junior Engineer to join our growing construction team. In this entry-level role, you will assist in the design, planning, and execution of construction projects. You will work closely with engineers, project managers, and construction teams to ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. This role offers excellent opportunities for learning and career development in the construction industry.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Support & Coordination:
  • Assist engineers in preparing and reviewing project plans, designs, and drawings
  • Support project teams in executing construction activities according to project schedules
  • Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, and subcontractors for the timely delivery of materials and resources
  • Technical Assistance:
  • Help conduct site inspections and surveys to ensure construction activities comply with design specifications
  • Assist in identifying and solving engineering problems as they arise during construction
  • Provide support in the development of engineering solutions for construction challenges
  • Documentation & Reporting:
  • Assist in the preparation and review of technical documentation such as drawings, specifications, and reports
  • Maintain up-to-date project documentation, including site reports, change orders, and progress tracking
  • Prepare and update project progress reports for internal use and client communication
  • Quality Control & Safety:
  • Assist in ensuring that all work meets required safety standards and complies with local building codes and regulations
  • Conduct inspections to ensure that construction materials, equipment, and work quality meet project requirements
  • Assist in identifying and mitigating safety hazards on construction sites
  • Cost & Schedule Tracking:
  • Assist in monitoring project schedules and budgets, ensuring that timelines and costs are adhered to
  • Support engineers in cost estimation, tracking resource allocation, and ensuring efficient use of materials and labor
  • Learning & Development:
  • Continuously develop technical and project management skills by working closely with experienced engineers and construction managers
  • Participate in training sessions, workshops, and site visits to enhance knowledge of construction practices and industry standards


Qualifications:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field
  • Experience:
  • 0-2 years of experience in the construction or engineering field (internships, co-op programs, or related academic experience is a plus)
  • Skills:
  • Basic understanding of construction processes, engineering principles, and materials
  • Familiarity with engineering software (eg, AutoCAD, Revit, MS Project) is an advantage
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work well in a team environment and collaborate effectively with others
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies


Soft Skills:

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage time effectively and meet deadlines.
  • Willingness to work in both office and field environments.

description: Group Services Metsä Group is a successful forest industry group with roots in the Finnish forest - Our parent company is a cooperative of over 90,000 forest owners. Metsä Group's Group Services employ some 1,000 professionals in finance, IT, sourcing and logistics, HR, technology, business process development, communications, law, and many other fields. Their task is to support Metsä Group and its Business Areas in implementing their strategy. Our specialists' independent work is supported by a strongly networked workplace community. We welcome people from diverse backgrounds and different stages of life. Metsä has space and opportunities for many kinds of talent, regardless of age, gender, ethnic background, sexual orientation, disability or other characteristics - Metsä is for all. Read more: metsagroup.com/metsaforall . This recruitment is carried out anonymously. Metsä Group is looking for an AI DEVELOPER to join our Digital & AI function in Espoo, Finland. What is the job that awaits you? As an AI Developer, you will play a key role in advancing the adoption of artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions across Metsä Group. You will design, develop, deploy and maintain production-grade AI capabilities that create measurable business value. In this role, you will transform business requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable AI solutions. You will develop AI applications, services and integrations using machine learning and generative AI technologies, deploy and monitor models in production environments and integrate AI capabilities into business processes, applications, APIs and data platforms. You will be responsible for industrializing AI and machine learning solutions. You will implement MLOps and AI engineering practices, build reliable deployment processes and continuously optimize solution performance, scalability, operational reliability and cost efficiency throughout the solution lifecycle. Collaboration is an essential part of your role. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Developers, Architects and business stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation of AI solutions. As a trusted expert, you will provide guidance on AI application development, MLOps, deployment architectures and the integration of AI into business processes and digital services. In addition, you will maintain development best practices in developers handbooks. This is a permanent position and you will report to the Development Manager, AI. What are we expecting of you? We are looking for an experienced and solution-oriented AI professional who combines strong software engineering skills with a practical understanding of machine learning, generative AI and cloud-based AI environments. You know how to take AI solutions beyond experimentation and build production-ready capabilities that are reliable, secure and maintainable. To succeed in this role, you should have: A Master's or PhD degree in Applied Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or another similar discipline. Strong expertise in AI application development, machine learning deployment and MLOps practices. Strong software engineering and programming skills in Python, together with experience using modern AI and machine learning frameworks. Experience with version control systems, such as Azure DevOps Repos, and building CI/CD pipelines. Hands-on experience in of AI solution development with Azure Databricks, Azure AI Foundry capabilities and Microsoft Azure cloud services. Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, Terraform or similar deployment tools and methodologies. A good understanding of scalable, secure and production-grade AI solution architectures and solution costs factors and FinOps. The ability to integrate AI capabilities into business processes, applications, APIs, digital services and data platforms. Strong collaboration and communication skills for working with both technical experts and business stakeholders. In addition, you understand the importance of responsible AI, governance and information security. You can balance technical quality with business value, scalability, maintainability and cost efficiency while ensuring that solutions comply with Metsä Group's architecture principles and development standards. Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio is seen as an advantage. Most importantly, you are passionate about turning AI innovations into practical solutions and helping shape the future of AI engineering at Metsä Group. Career in the new era at Metsä Group An international growth business - build a successful career At Metsä Group. The forest industry is a prime example of the bioeconomy and circular economy, and shows the way to the future. Megatrends such as urbanisation and rising living standards are driving Metsä Group's business and the shift to renewable fossil free raw materials. With us, you'll get to develop future skills, business and products with a long-term perspective, together with our top professionals. Our big company offers a wide range of career opportunities and many interesting challenges. Metsä Group has a responsible corporate culture that creates a safe working environment for all of us. We value good leadership and support for personal career development. We encourage you to display your competence and will provide you with opportunities to use it. Anonymous recruitment - this is how it works This is an anonymous recruitment process. The gender and date of birth of the applicant are not asked for on the application form. Personal details such as name, mother tongue, time of studies, name of educational institution and contact details are hidden until the interview stage. Attachments (such as CVs) are also hidden. Recruiters have access to the contact details of those invited for interview once the applicant has been selected for interview. Our system will guide you through the application process. The questions on the application form will help you present your skills and experience anonymously. Answer all questions carefully. If you're invited for interview, your CV will be displayed to the recruiters to support the interview. Read more and watch the video on anonymous recruitment. https://www.metsagroup.com/careers/work-with-us/anonymous-recruitment/ Would you like to know more? Contact us! Because the application process is anonymous, we don't record any information about people who contact us. So don't hesitate to call us if you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process itself. For more information about the position, please contact Solution Architect, AI Elmeri Waljus. You can reach Elmeri by phone +358 (50) 4041988 best on 8.10. between 14-15 and on 13.10. between 13-14. What happens next? Click on the link above to apply. Note that attachments won't be visible in anonymous recruitment until the interview stage, so it's important to fill in the application form carefully. Please send your application as soon as possible, as we'll already start processing applications during the application period. Please include your cv and salary request. You'll receive a confirmation message the next morning after your application has been received. The application will be open until 19.10.2026. We wish you the best of luck!

description: # **Forward Deployed Engineer** Sydney or Melbourne (Hybrid) ## **About Nash** Nash is building the digital logistics infrastructure that powers delivery for some of the world’s largest retailers, tech platforms, and delivery services. Our platform connects merchants, carriers, and customers through unified AI-driven logistics, helping enterprises like Walmart, Woolworths, 7-Eleven, and Coles orchestrate millions of deliveries every month. We’re now expanding our engineering presence in Australia and looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who can ship code, solve real customer problems, and help shape how Nash scales across APAC. ## **The Role** This is hands-on engineering at the edge — not pre-sales, not implementation. You’ll build, deploy, and operate production software directly with customers while working closely with our global product and AI teams. You’ll be part of the foundational team defining how our Australia engineering office operates. Expect to move fast, own outcomes, and see your work drive real-world impact within weeks, not quarters. ## **What You’ll Do** • Build and deploy production systems used by top enterprise retailers • Work directly with customers’ engineering, ops, and leadership teams • Take new products from concept to live deployments • Design and extend core infrastructure underpinning global delivery orchestration • Partner with product and AI teams to influence direction across APAC • Debug real-world logistics workflows across fleets, APIs, and integrations ## **Who You Are** • 4 plus years building and shipping production software • Strong experience with APIs, backend systems, or platform integrations • Comfortable jumping between code, customer problems, and architecture decisions • Bias toward speed, iteration, and ownership • Clear communicator who can work directly with operators, CTOs, and execs • Motivated by building software that touches the physical world at scale ## **Why This Role** If you’ve wanted to join a high-velocity YC-backed startup redefining how logistics works worldwide — while getting to build and see your code operate inside real enterprise workflows — this is the one. Your work will touch millions of deliveries each month and help define Nash’s engineering footprint across APAC. **More about** [**Nash**](http://Nash.AI) ### **Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.** Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco. ### **What You’ll Love About Us** ✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career! ✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates ✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity ✅ Flexible paid time off ✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

description: Merista builds the physical AI workforce for food production. This is our founding team robotics hire, reporting to the CTO, owning the robot’s mind, and everything between intent and motion. Full-time and on-site in Barcelona. **The challenge** Food changes shape, sticks to tools, and behaves differently as containers empty. A successful movement can still produce an incorrect portion. A policy that works in a demonstration may struggle after hours of operation. That means the hard problems are the whole job: * How do we connect perception and manipulation when appearance alone doesn’t tell us how food will behave? * How do we control portion weight while meeting cycle-time requirements? * How do we detect a failed transfer and recover without stopping the line? * How do we collect demonstrations and production data that lead to measurable improvements? We expect robot learning to play an important role. You’ll help determine where it earns its place, how to evaluate it, and how it should work with sensing, control, and mechanical design. **What you’d own** You’ll lead technical choices across manipulation, learning, and control, working with perception and mechatronics engineers to define the interfaces. You’ll own the path from a policy’s output to reliable motion on the robot, including real-time execution, failure detection, and recovery. Your responsibility continues into deployment, where we find out which assumptions survive. * Execution and feedback control: trajectory generation, contact-rich manipulation, force control, and portion-weight feedback. You’ll connect policy outputs to real-time control, manage inference latency and timing, and define how the robot responds when an action cannot execute as intended. * Failure detection and recovery: detecting failed transfers and interrupted actions, bringing the robot to a safe state, and resuming work reliably. You’ll build automatic recovery where practical and give a remote operator the context and control needed to intervene. * Manipulation policies and learning: deciding what the policy outputs, how it is trained and evaluated, and where imitation learning, reinforcement learning, simulation, or conventional control earn their place with limited fleet data. * Data and evaluation: capturing useful demonstrations, failures, and recoveries, and building repeatable tests that show whether changes improve accuracy, speed, and reliability. **What you bring** * Hands-on experience building and running control software on real robot arms, including trajectory execution and feedback from sensors. You have taken manipulation from a demonstration into repeated, reliable operation. * Practical understanding of control-loop timing, latency, and fault handling. You can explain a failure you diagnosed on a physical robot, how you made it recover, and how you verified the fix. * Practical understanding of robot learning or related ML, including data quality, evaluation, and deployment. * Strong Python and enough systems understanding to debug across sensors, models, control, and hardware. * Evidence that you can take an ambiguous problem, design useful experiments, and learn from failures. * Interest in working closely with mechanical and mechatronics engineers. You don’t need prior food-industry experience. Show us something you built, what broke, and how you improved it. **About us** Most meals in the developed world pass through a food factory. The hardest and most repetitive manipulation tasks on the line still defeat machines, like portioning and assembling real food in small batches that frequently change. So people do them by hand in cold and wet rooms. Factories cannot keep those rooms staffed. Merista builds the physical AI workforce for food production: operated robots that take over these tasks. One robot rolls onto a factory floor without rebuilding the line. We deploy it and run it, and the factory pays for the work it does. We've already built and operated a multi-site robotic fleet for restaurants, dealt with production failures, field operations, remote recovery, hardware iteration, deployments and customers. Now we're starting again with a much more ambitious technical thesis. Our long-term vision is the self-driving food factory. The work today is one task at a time. **Why join at this stage** The core technical choices are still open. Your work will shape the data we collect, how we measure progress, and what we deploy. Our longer-term thesis is that useful factory deployments can create a compounding learning advantage: observe real failures, capture the right data, improve the system, and carry those improvements into the next deployment. Building that loop is part of this role. As the team grows, you can deepen your technical ownership or move toward team leadership. We value both paths. Expect hardware delays, repeated experiments, and production debugging alongside new development. Part of the job is standing on a factory floor at 6am, watching a robot fail, and working with the team to understand what needs to change. We always find ways to adapt, improvise, and overcome. If you enjoy owning the whole path from an idea to a working machine, there is a great deal here to build.

Because we will operate the robots, you’ll see the consequences of your designs directly. A difficult repair, an unreliable seal, or a tool that holds onto food becomes evidence for the next iteration. Building that feedback into the engineering process is part of this job. As the team grows, you can deepen your technical ownership or move toward team leadership. We value both paths. description: AV-alan ammattilaisena sinä saat asiat toimimaan. Caverionilla työsi näkyy toimivina AV-ratkaisuina, sujuvina asiakaskokemuksina ja ympäristöinä, joissa teknologia palvelee käyttäjiään parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla. Meillä pääset osaksi ammattilaisten tiimiä, jossa hommat hoituvat ja projektit valmistuvat. Meille "toimii" ei ole vain sana. Se on asenne ja lupaus siitä, että hommat hoidetaan. Älyllä, taidolla, tarkkuudella, sinnikkyydellä, omistautumisella ja tekemisen meiningillä. Etsimme joukkoomme ammattitaitoista AV-ohjelmoijaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Toimipaikkasi voi olla Turku tai Tampere. Tehtäväsi Työsi on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Päiväsi voi koostua esimerkiksi ohjelmoinnista toimistolla ja etänä, asiakkaan luona tehtävästä ohjelmoinnista, teknisestä tuesta tai vianetsinnästä. Työ on itsenäistä, mutta et ole yksin - tukenasi on motivoitunut ja avulias AV-tiimi sekä caverit ympäri Suomen. Pääsääntöisiä tehtäviäsi ovat: AV-järjestelmien ohjelmointi Crestron-järjestelmää käyttäen - tämä on tehtävässä välttämätön osaaminen. Tekninen tuki ja etätuki. Vianetsintä ja ongelmatilanteiden ratkaiseminen. Järjestelmien käyttöönotot asiakkaiden kohteissa. Järjestelmien toimivuuden varmistaminen ja asiakkaiden tukeminen. Liikut työssäsi pääasiassa Turun ja Tampereen alueilla, ja työmatkat ovat yleensä enintään muutaman päivän mittaisia. Pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa kohteissa eri asiakassegmenteissä, kuten yritysten ja organisaatioiden kokous- ja koulutustiloissa, julkishallinnon ja oppilaitosten projekteissa sekä tapahtuma-, messu-, ravintola- ja hotelliympäristöissä. Työaikasi on pääsääntöisesti arkisin klo 8-16. Oletko sinä toimivan elämän tekijä? Viihdyt varmasti Caverionilla, jos sinulla on: Muutama vuosi kokemusta AV-ohjelmoinnista. Kokemusta Crestron-järjestelmällä ohjelmoinnista sekä audiopuolen ohjelmoinnista - nämä ovat tehtävässä välttämättömiä osaamisia. Soveltuva koulutustausta, esimerkiksi automaatio- tai tietotekniikan insinöörikoulutus. Korkeakoulututkinto ei kuitenkaan ole välttämätön, jos sinulla on tehtävään tarvittava käytännön osaaminen ja ohjelmointitaito. Osaamisesi voi olla kertynyt esimerkiksi työn, itseopiskelun tai laitevalmistajien sertifikaattikoulutusten kautta. Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito. B-ajokortti, mahdollisuus käyttää omaa autoa työssä sekä matkustusvalmius pääasiassa Turun ja Tampereen alueilla. Oma-aloitteinen työote ja hyvät organisointitaidot itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Palveluhenkisyyttä ja hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot tiimityöhön ja asiakaskohtaamisiin. Nuhteeton tausta. Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle tehdään turvallisuusselvitys hänen suostumuksellaan. Entä mitä me tarjoamme sinulle? ✅ Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön ja oman tiimin tuen, laajat koulutus- ja kehitysmahdollisuudet sekä avoimen ja osallistavan työkulttuurin. ✅ Mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisten kohteiden ja kiinnostavien asiakkuuksien parissa. ✅ Sopivasti vapautta ja vastuuta sekä ensiluokkaiset työvälineet tukemaan työskentelyäsi. ✅ Laajat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut. ✅ Yhteen hiileen puhaltavan ja sitoutuneen työyhteisön, joka auttaa sinua kehittymään urallasi. Käy kurkkaamassa Caverikirjasta, millaista meillä on olla töissä. Jos tämä kuulosti seuraavalta työpaikaltasi, toimi nyt! Viimeinen hakupäivä on 25.10.2026, mutta käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana. Tehtävä voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten älä jää turhaan odottelemaan! Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antavat: Turun projektipäällikkö Tuomas Riekki, puh. 050 3296961 Tampereen projektipäällikkö Saku Mäkelä, puh. 050 410 8362 Tutustu toimivan elämän tekijän tarinaan. Tervetuloa suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan toimivan elämän ratkaisuja!
